# Tip: The "Cold Shoulder" Double-Barreled Shotgun (Game Board / Season 12)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_133_nukaknights-post-kalte-schulter-spielbrett-12.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Maybe some of you have also seen the latest Angry Turtle video. The "**Cold Shoulder**" (from the Season 12 board) is actually not a simple paint job, but a **double-barreled shotgun** with the legendary perks:

- Quadruple
- +50% damage against cryptids
- Target freezes with reduced movement speed for 4 seconds. Adds cold damage.

Like the Nuka launcher, it only costs **2 legendary modules** to produce. The weapon can be crafted at level 15 / 25 / 35 / 45 and requires the Weaponsmith card at 2* during crafting.

![Cold Shoulder Manufacturing](/uploads/skywalka55-fallout76-20230416-20-17-52.jpg)

The special thing about it is the high **cold damage**. 

To put the cold shoulder to the test, I compared it directly with a Quad Explo +15% fast reload double-barreled shotgun (QE15). A QE15 is usually the ultimate in shotguns and plays really well. I tested various opponents and even with super mutants level 60-100, the Cold Shoulder needs one shot less per opponent than the QE15. This makes it really playable and much easier to obtain than a Quadruple Explo 15 Double Barrel Shotgun.

Try it out for yourself. You can unlock the Cold Shoulder at **Rank 5** on **Game Board 12**.

See also: All Season 12 Rewards: RIP Daring on the Cryptid Hunt (Board 12)
